# partiteai_a2ui_form (Data Source)

Builds the definition of an A2UI task form, for the `A2UI` entry of a task definition's `ui_forms`, from components given as a type and a JSON object of properties. It works with any catalog. The form is checked against the catalog when it is read. Checks that need the task's schemas, such as whether an action's context fits the output, happen when the task definition is saved. For the basic catalog, `partiteai_a2ui_basic_form` has a block for each component type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) A full A2UI catalog definition, as JSON. Its `catalogId` is the catalog clients render the form with, and every `$ref` in it must point into it. Without it, the components come from the A2UI v0.9 basic catalog.
- `completed` (Block, Optional) The surface that replaces the open one once the task is completed, with the task output as its data model. It can't have event actions. Without it, the surface is removed once the task is completed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--completed))
- `open` (Block, Optional) The surface shown while the task is open. Its data model starts as the task input, and every event action completes the task with its context as the output. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open))

### Read-Only

- `definition` (String) The form's definition, as JSON. Use it as the `A2UI` entry of a task definition's `ui_forms`.

<a id="nestedblock--completed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `completed`

Optional:

- `component` (Block List) A component of the surface. One of them must have the ID `root`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--completed--component))

<a id="nestedblock--completed--component"></a>
### Nested Schema for `completed.component`

Required:

- `id` (String) The component's ID, unique in the surface.
- `type` (String) The component type, as the catalog names it, such as `Text` or `Button`.

Optional:

- `overlay` (Block List) Sets a value of the component from the task input when the task starts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--completed--component--overlay))
- `properties` (String) The component's other properties, as a JSON object in the shape the catalog gives them, such as `jsonencode({ text = { path = "/question" } })`.

<a id="nestedblock--completed--component--overlay"></a>
### Nested Schema for `completed.component.overlay`

Required:

- `expression` (String) A CEL expression that sees the task input as `input`, such as `input.options.map(o, {'label': o, 'value': o})`. An empty optional, such as `input.?subtitle`, removes the value.
- `pointer` (String) A JSON pointer to the value in the component as A2UI writes it, with property names in camel case, such as `/text` or `/action/event/context/answer`.

Optional:

- `component` (Block List) A component of the surface. One of them must have the ID `root`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open--component))
